summary: Check-Cap Ltd filed a Form 6-K updating progress on its pending merger with MBody AI Corp, announced September 12, 2025. Shareholders approved the merger on November 14, 2025. The filing discloses expected board committee compositions effective upon closing, including audit, compensation, and nominating committees, with director independence determinations under Nasdaq rules. No deal terms, pricing, or advisor details are provided. The merger is anticipated to close, subject to conditions. Watch for closing completion and integration risks, plus regulatory approvals.
